notes.title: " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" Update log
notes.content:
Hello bosses!

Thank you for your support and feedback on " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000"！
Today’s update is here! Although the members of the studio are very busy, but seeing everyone having fun in the game, we think it is worth!

This update is mainly for bug fixes and experience optimization:

·Bug fix
- Fixed the bug that the lower left corner shows an error “7777” due to the dismissal of the employee. 
- Fixed the bug of not being able to get a sense of belonging by skipping recruitment.

·optimization
- Optimized the display of the amount of furniture, themes and other items.
- Optimized the numerical system of "employee motivation" function.

·New features
- Choosing n+1 or 2n when dismissing employees will make other employees feel that the boss is very conscientious, so the sense of belonging will increase.
- Press the "+" key on the small keyboard to double the speed (the original speed will be restored when entering the exhibition, please accelerate after the employees to return to their positions to prevent errors).

You can get a better game experience by updating, thank you again for your support! Welcome to join our official QQ group for more information and feedback: 1005661002.

notes.title: " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" Update log
notes.content:
Hello bosses!

Thank you for your support and feedback on " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" since its release. We received a lot of feedback, and we have been fixing bugs and optimizing the game day and night. Although there were many difficulties, you still gave us a lot of encouragement, which enabled us to move forward. We will continue to work hard to bring you the best experience!

We have made a version update; this update is mainly for bug fixes and experience optimization:

·Bug fix
- Fixed the bug that some rooms could not clear the negative status of employees correctly
- Fixed the bug that the employee information bar was not displayed properly

·optimization
- Optimized the CPU usage of the game
- In-game font size adjustment
- Logical adjustment of the number of fans
- Logic adjustment of dream income
- Employees will now call "Boss" according to the player's settings

We noticed that high CPU usage is a problem that players are very concerned about. However, due to time constraints, the optimization of the CPU usage is not very obvious this time, but we are still continuing to optimize!

Welcome to join our official QQ group for more information and feedback: 1005661002.

notes.title: The main design of Game Company Simulator: Back to 2000
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Bai Qi Gu Gu. Recently, we are busy with the progress of the game and the school graduation project. We are very gratified that our game is almost finished and here is the main design of Game Company Simulator: Back to 2000.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/a88c569a73fe618785ca172bc8fd9a7b7db3f2a9.png[/img]

The main line of the game's business is to make a game project. In the game, the process is divided into 8 aspects, which are gradually advanced and formed into a loop, as follows:

1.  Gamer preference
  Gamer preference is actually a simplification of market research in the game. Players should make game projects that meet gamer preferences Gamer attributes and Gamer base will increase the sales of the game, and then the sales of the game will also increase the number of corresponding gamers;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/f8ebb1e7de0646589257c2ff1add1edabebd3a6a.png[/img]

2. Game type
Players can only choose 5 basic game types at first. As the achievement points of a certain game type continue to increase, this type of game will be upgraded. For example, basic strategy games will gradually be upgraded to stand-alone strategy games. More advanced game genres are more attractive to fans who like this game type, but at the same time the requirements for employees will be higher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/3dcebdd183d458ac7f959132fdba6f2f73e1442a.png[/img]

3. Game theme
There are 6 types of themes in the game for players to match, and players need to choose the most suitable game theme according to the game type. After completing a round of game production, you will accumulate experience and upgrade the selected theme type. Each theme can level up to level 7 and unlock more advanced theme content. A few themes can be purchased for money

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/e8a46dc2f2fa2168b75bf31260b98c89d78f9824.png[/img]

4. Producer
The producer will carry out the basic work in the early stage of the game, and will increase the upper limit of the project based on professional ability. A planner as a producer will strengthen the related operating feel, strategic gameplay, and collection and development attributes. An artist as a producer will strengthen the attributes of the character's original painting, action special effects, and scene worldview. The programmer as a producer will develop more balanced development .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/ddc82fb9aabf647a61313dce978d4add2660d198.png[/img]

5. Node planning
Node planning can determine the focus of the next stage in the game production process, and different development directions will require different numbers of employees. Each node planning will make the project attributes continue to improve, but at the same time will incur more development costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/588286cff1b73e23f877bc2e5106d99de9523cab.png[/img]

6. Quality attributes
For the quality attributes of the game, you can view the attribute six-pointed star picture, and you can also click the button of ‘confirm the sale’, and judge based on the evaluation of the system, such as "just so so", "really cool", if you are not satisfied with the quality of the game, you can choose to continue the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/8783aca287d95b22f1a2a776507168710bfc4674.png[/img]

7. Product price
The system will suggest a range of product price based on quality, and provide players with reference. After the player determines the price, there will be a store evaluation interface, and ganmers after the purchase will judge whether the price is appropriate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/1499b02a89a7c1d4008c4586992f29ae2c6b3948.png[/img]

8. Game sales
After the project ends, the game sales interface will pop up to summarize the current round of projects. This interface contains the composition of income and expenditure inside and outside the current round of the project. Players can adjust the next round of projects according to the revenue situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39562486/20258286b441ee2864cc96855c2913b3c63572d8.png[/img]

Thank you for reading and we will keep updating the developer daily.

Best Regards
